verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own docs show a snooze feature: messages can be snoozed and later return to the Inbox at a scheduled time. Nothing in the evidence shows follow-up reminders that resurface a thread only if nobody replies, so only the snooze half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: conditional no-reply follow-up reminders, detailed snooze documentation (conversation-level scope, time options), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: Snooze messages to just when you need them.
If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
